taskIdentityRule: Every governed task has one immutable task ID. No duplicate repair or closure task IDs.
schoolContextRule: Preserve School Context Rule — learner identity, school scope, and role separation must not be bypassed.
contentGovernanceRule: Preserve Content Governance Rule — approved sources only, curriculum integrity, no unverified content.
privacyAndSafeguardingRule: Preserve Privacy and Safeguarding Rule — no raw student data exposure, PII protection, access separation.
socraticTutorRule: Preserve Socratic Tutor Rule — no final answers, scaffold learning, no answer bot behavior.
frontendBoundary: Frontend tasks operate only in frontend-owned paths and explicitly declared shared dependencies. No backend, AI, or infrastructure modification unless authorized.
backendBoundary: Backend tasks operate only in backend-owned paths and explicitly declared dependencies. No frontend, AI, or infrastructure expansion.
aiBoundary: AI tasks operate only in AI-owned paths. No production backend mutation or frontend UI changes.
webResearchComposerModeRule: Web Research must be treated as an AI mode inside the existing composer experience. No standalone Research Panel or duplicate research navigation.
sevenThemePreservation: All seven production themes must be preserved. Frontend tasks must validate all required themes with separate machine-verified evidence.
ownerBrowserProtection: Owner browser profiles must not be modified, reused, or terminated by governed tasks.
noForegroundServerRule: Governed tasks must not run foreground development servers. Servers must be launched as detached children with PID ownership.
noBroadStagingRule: Git add . / -A / --all are forbidden. All staging must use exact path lists through task-governor.mjs stage.
noPushRule: Governed tasks must not push to remote repositories.
noAcceptanceExpansionRule: Acceptance criteria may not be added, removed, or changed after task manifest lock.
backlogSeparationRule: Discoveries outside the immutable manifest must be recorded as backlog items, not manifest changes.
